offering_description.value: Strattec sells vehicle locks, keys, latches and powered access systems to automakers and the automotive aftermarket. It designs and manufactures mechanical and electronic assemblies that let drivers unlock, open and close vehicle doors and liftgates.

primary_products.value: Vehicle locks and keys; electronic key fobs; door handles; door and liftgate latches; powered door and liftgate systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Automakers and automotive replacement parts distributors

end_markets.value: Passenger vehicle and light truck manufacturing; automotive replacement parts

revenue_model.value: product sales: Original equipment vehicle access assemblies and aftermarket replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Turns metal, plastics and electronics into vehicle access assemblies for automakers and aftermarket distributors

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Mechanical locks and keys, electronic access controls, handles, latches and powered closures

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Supply relationships with automakers for new vehicle programs; distributors / dealers: Automotive aftermarket distributors serving locksmiths and repair shops

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle door latches and locks are subject to federal motor vehicle safety standards

notes: The extent of direct sales outside North America is uncertain.
